scene bedroom_day
When the morning comes, the night prior feels as if it never even happened.
Like it was all some sort of dream dreamt in advance before my subsequent slumber and an even more subsequent sea of black.
The first thing I think about when I wake up is thanking my organs, though I’m not quite sure why.

Though, I know there must be some sort of correlation between the spontaneity of such a nonsensical desire and the much more sensical (Which isn’t actually a word for some reason) need to see Miku again.
The second thought I have is that it might be time for a change of color.
I could paint my room. Or get a new shirt. Maybe even dye my hair and start my “bad boy” phase.
A third and mostly related thought is that something needs to change.
A fourth is that something will.
And a fifth is that I’m not sure if I’ll like it or not.
scene black
My sixth thought involves getting dressed.
The seventh, leaving the room.
scene mikuvisitafter1
: Oh, good timing. I was just about to come get you and passive-aggressively ask why Miku is here to see you this early in the morning.
: That’s a good question, Ami...I was under the impression I was going to have to go see her.
: Hahah...hah...
: Sorry if I’m gettin’ you in trouble, Sensei. I just...you know...wanted to talk about last night and stuff...
: Well, I didn’t like that sentence one bit.
: It’s not like that, Ami. There was just-
scene mikuvisitafter2
: You don’t have to tell me, Sensei. I’m just being difficult because that’s what I’m used to doing.
: I’ll leave you two alone. I have to go to work anyway. We just added a bunch of new menu items and Uta wants all of us to remember them by Tuesday.
: You’re going to just...leave me alone in the house with another girl?
scene mikuvisitafter3
: It’s just Miku. It’s not like I’m leaving you here with Kirin or Noriko. Plus, everyone knows better than to show up for funny business with you while I’m home.
: The real risky ones are the girls who do it behind my back. So Miku actually gains points for asking me if she could come inside.
: Not like she needs or wants them, though. This is probably just to clear up some sort of misunderstanding, right?
scene mikuvisitafter4
: I’m not really sure if...“misunderstanding” is the right word, but...I ain’t lyin’ when I say I’m not here for any sorta funny business.
: Well, all I can really do is take your word for it. So, whatever is going on, I hope you two can figure it out.
: Until then, I have like five soups and a few drinks to memorize.
: That doesn’t seem like that many, Ami.
scene mikuvisitafter5
: Then I’ll be back before there’s even a chance for any funny business.
scene mikuvisitafter6
: Breakfast is in the fridge and coffee is already brewed! Have a nice day, Sensei! I love you!
Ami...leaves the house.
And suddenly, there are two girls I need to bring to the doctor.
: So, how are we tackling this? Because, based on the way you’ve been nervously fidgeting since I came out of my bedroom, I doubt you’re going to be yelling at me again.
: Course I ain’t gonna yell at you, Sensei. Shouldn’t have yelled at ya last night either. That’s kinda the first thing I wanted to talk about.
: Well, go ahead. You can take the reins on this one. I’ll just stand here and figure out what I’m supposed to do with you.
: Yeah...yeah, that’s...fair...
scene mikuvisitafter7
: Hahah...this...this feels kind of familiar, right? You remember the first time you found out about my...brain thingy? And how I had to apologize back then too?
: I do. But I also remember that I’m the one who visited you back then.
scene mikuvisitafter8
: And I was surprised you did...
: Kinda figured you’d want nothin’ to do with me after freakin’ out on ya like that.

: But...it’s been a long time since then and...it might not seem like it to you, but I think I’ve changed a lot. And you and me are...a lot closer now. Even if it’s just...you know...in a naughty way...
: It’s not just that, Miku.
: I know, yeah. Yeah. But, like...what I’m sayin’ is...I’m like...
: I trust you now...and stuff...and just sittin’ around and waitin’ for you to come to me gives me all sorts of...butterflies and...yeah...
: To tell ya the truth, I’ve actually been wanderin’ around your neighborhood for, like...four or five hours or something.
: What? It’s only like 9:00 AM.
: Yeah...I couldn’t really sleep.
scene mikuvisitafter9
: But I was nice enough to let you sleep in, so...I didn’t do anything wrong. Right? I just couldn’t really...you know...
: Waiting is...
scene mikuvisitafter10
: Sensei, I’m really sorry. I’m sorry I keep puttin’ you in positions like this because of the kinda girl I am.
: This position is a little different from that first one, Miku. This is way more serious.
: I know, I know. That first time, you could’ve given me a pass or somethin’. But this time, I’ve gotta apologize because this time I actually messed up. Like, a lot.
: It ain’t like I’m gettin’ all weird because of my...condition. I blamed you for a thing you didn’t have anythin’ to do with and that was all sortsa messed up in a million different ways.
: I know you were just tryin’ to help. And even if it was you who took everythin’ away, I shouldn’t have gone off on ya like that.
: You’re giving me too much credit, Miku.
scene mikuvisitafter11
: What do you mean by “givin’ you too much credit?”
: I mean that saying I was just trying to help is making me sound a lot better than I actually am when I shrugged this off time and time again.
: If I really wanted to help, I would have done something sooner.
: That ain’t true. Buttin’ into somebody else’s life ain’t always easy, Sensei. I ain’t gonna blame you for not doin’ somethin’ earlier. I’m sure you had your reasons.
: But the point is...I get how dangerous what I was doin’ was now. And I ain’t gonna do it anymore.
: Maki’s gonna take me to a real doctor and...I’m gonna figure out where to go from there.
: Sounds like a lot has happened in the last twelve hours, huh?
scene mikuvisitafter12
: Friggin’ tell me about it.
: No. You tell me about it. What did happen after I left last night?
scene black
Miku agrees to open up about what happened when Makoto came home, and the two of us make our way over to the couch...
scene mikuvisitafter13
There’s a moment of silence when we get there, but it’s no different from the hundreds of other moments of silence I’ve had before hundreds of other difficult conversations.
And while Miku’s managed to avoid most of those, she does have her moments every now and then. It’s just hard for her to have more substantial ones when she’s still so secretive about everything.
I don’t blame her for that. How could I? I’m just noting that it makes things harder.
But no one said this would be easy. No one said any of this would be easy, and I’m learning more and more of exactly what that means every single day.
There’s likely nothing I can do to help her. But I can listen.
And sometimes, that’s all a person needs.
: Without beatin’ around the bush, nobody took anythin’ from me at all. I just...kinda forgot where I put the bag Io gave me.
: I had a bad episode before school that day, so I took a little too much to try and calm myself down and...must’ve put what was left somewhere I wasn’t exactly used to or somethin’.
: But...that ain’t gonna be a problem anymore since Makoto found it before I was able to and gave me the lecture of a friggin’ lifetime.
Ah...so it wasn’t a change of heart for Io after all.
I should have known.
: So Makoto knows now?
scene mikuvisitafter14
: I told her everythin’ except where I was gettin’ ‘em.
: I didn’t wanna throw Io under the bus like that when she’s got enough goin’ on.
: And how did Makoto take that?
: She was shocked. Cried a lot. Asked me a bunch of questions I had a hard time answerin’ since I was panickin’ the whole time.
: Seein’ her like that started to calm me down, though. Felt like I was bein’ a...huge disappointment after all she’s done for me. So I just started spillin’ out my guts all rapid-fire like.
: She flushed the leftover medicine down the toilet and called Maki to make an appointment thingy for me. Didn’t even care that I didn’t wanna talk to them. Just didn’t want me to get hurt.
scene mikuvisitafter15
: I left you out of it too, ya know. Far as Makoto’s concerned, you were just in the wrong place at the wrong time.
: I doubt she’s going to buy that I wasn’t at least partially involved in this. She’s too smart for that.
: You really weren’t, though. All ya did was try and talk me out of it. You tried talkin’ Io out of it too, didn’t ya? So why do you keep blamin’ yourself for this?
: Because I’m an adult. It’s my responsibility to do something about stuff like this if I’m made aware of it.
: The heck’s bein’ an adult have to do with anythin’? People are people and talkin’ to other people can get pretty hard. You ain’t responsible for me.
: I literally am. I’m your teacher.
: But you’re also my friend, ain’t ya? And that’s the sorta thing most friends who aren’t named Makoto would have a tough time dealin’ with.
: Only one to blame here is me. I’m an idiot and didn’t realize what I was gettin’ myself into. But thanks to you guys, I’m gonna try and be better from now on. Promise.
: Is there anything you need from me?
scene mikuvisitafter16
: If there’s any way I can help, just tell me. I’m obviously no doctor- and if you want to absolve me of my partial responsibility for what happened, fine. But if there’s anything I can do-
: There...
scene mikuvisitafter17
: Okay, so...
: Remember how I was talkin’ about how far we’ve come and how much I’ve changed and...and how much I trust you and all that?
: That wasn’t all that long ago, so...yeah. I remember.
: Well...um...
: Uhh...
scene mikuvisitafter18
: There...there ain’t a lot of people who know about...why I’m like this...and why I ain’t good at talkin’ about it or...how I kinda can’t talk about it...
: But if I’m gonna be ruinin’ your life all the time like I have been, I think I owe it to you to at least try...especially if they’re gonna make me tell this story to doctors and stuff soon...
: Are you sure you want to tell me?
: No. But if you keep askin’ me questions like that, chances are I’m never gonna. I can’t have an option when it comes to this. I’ve gotta just...I’ve gotta do it. I’ve gotta tell you.
scene mikuvisitafter19
: When I...
: Umm...
: Uhh...
: Sorry...it’s been years since I’ve had to...I don’t even know how to...
: Take your time. It’s fine.
scene mikuvisitafter20
: Hah...
scene black
: When I was little...
: Two men broke into my house.
scene mikuvisitafter21
: I don’t know about this...maybe we should leave?
: I got out of bed to get a drink of water or...
: Or maybe it was milk or...
: No. No, the drink doesn’t matter. But I got out of bed, walked down the hallway and...
: And there they were.
: And do what? Go back home and go to sleep like we didn’t break into someone’s fucking house? Just be quiet and take as much as you can.
: Since I had just woken up, I wasn’t able to see really well, but...I could tell something was wrong.
: They’ve got a kid...
: My dad...had friends over a lot. So at first I thought it might just be some of them, but...
: So do I. But if I don’t come up with enough money by the end of the week, that could change.
: We don’t have time for questions and observations. Just take anything that might be valuable. Now.
scene mikuvisitafter22
: I...I think I heard one of them say something about...about taking our stuff, so...
: So I tried to be quiet and go tell my...my parents, but...
: I think...I think they might have heard me...or...
: Did you hear something just now?
: Whatever it was is gone now. So put the fucking frame down and start going through their drawers.
scene mikuvisitafter23
: When I made it into their room, I shook them awake...I told them...I told them there were people in our house...
: And at first, they didn’t believe me. We...weren’t rich or anything, so...why would anyone...uh...
: Anyway...uhh...umm...
: When...when they finally heard something in the...living room or...maybe it was the kitchen? Or...
scene mikuvisitafter24
: My dad...he...uhh...
: When the sounds...happened, he...
: The door and...
: And there was yelling and...
: And my mom had me hide under the bed and...
: There was more yelling and...then a bang...
: Then another and...
: And the yelling got quieter...and quieter...
: And quieter...
: And...and then it stopped...
: So I...from under the bed...I...
: Then...the living room and...
: And they were...
: Both of them were...
: I was...I couldn’t...
: I kept trying to wake them up...
: I didn’t believe it...I still don’t...I don’t understand...
: Why us?...What did we do wrong?...
scene mikuvisitafter25
: Was it my fault?...
: If I never woke up...If I never got thirsty...If I was quieter...
: Then maybe...maybe they would...
: It’s not your fault, Miku...
: But...because of me...all of this happened...because of me...
: There is no “because of” anyone. Some things just happen without a reason.
: My mom...and dad...
: For no reason?...
: None?...
: I don’t know. There’s nothing I can say here to make you feel any better.
: All I can do here is listen.
: But I’m glad you finally told me.
scene mikuvisitafter26
: That’s why...any time I hear a loud noise, I...
: It’s like I’m back there...
: In my old house...
: Trying to wake them up...
: But...
: But they never do...
: I just want it to stop.
: I want to stop going back there.
: I need help.
: You’ll get help if you’re willing to admit that. Maki will make sure of it. Makoto too.
: I’m a burden to them. They’ve done so much for me and all I am is a burden to them.
: Don’t feel too bad about that. I’m a burden to everyone around me and I’m able to live with myself just fine.
: Can I use your bathroom please?
: Only if you promise you’re not going to pull your hair out in there.
: Then can I use your bed?
: Yes, Miku...
scene black
: You can use my bed.
I sit on the floor as Miku sobs herself to sleep for the first time in over twenty-four hours.
And I silently applaud her for being much stronger than I am at less than half my age.
The mystery’s been solved. And even though some of the details are still a little fuzzy, that’s okay.
I don’t need to know everything.
Because what I do know now is more than I deserve.
But it’s enough to make me want to stand by her every step of the way.
Even if I have to walk on glass.

scene bedroom_night
When Ami comes home, I thank her for leaving Miku and me alone today.
She returns the favor with samples of five different types of soup and a hug that lasts the rest of the night.
scene black
